name: inspira-ripple
title: Ripple
blurb: Concentric circles scale and pulse outward on a loop from center.
description: Renders expanding circular borders that shrink and repeat from the center. Each circle animates with a staggered delay to create a radiating wave effect.
use_when: Hero sections or immersive backgrounds that need a pulsing radial signal of activity.
avoid_when: Overlapping interactive content — expanding circles can obscure elements. Requires a positioned parent.
a11y: Passive background effect; child content provides focus and keyboard access. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
